topic: Can MVDR beamforming sufficiently compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures?
consensus_response: MVDR beamforming can reduce gain loss in array-fed reflectors during element failures, but it may not completely eliminate the effect of failed elements. The defocused reflector suffers less from failed elements compared to the conventional reflector, but it still experiences some reduction in gain. Additional feed elements or curved arrays can further mitigate the issue, but they add complexity and cost. Optimizing the reflector surface and feed array together, possibly with the aid of machine learning, could offer a more general solution, but it requires significant computational resources and careful consideration of manufacturability and reliability.
